root_cause.text: The VRR timing registers (TRANS_VRR_VMAX/FLIPLINE) were programmed before the corresponding TRANS_DDI_FUNC_CTL was enabled, violating hardware sequencing requirements and causing a system hang (MCE) on ICL.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "Apparently ICL may hang with an MCE if we write TRANS_VRR_VMAX/FLIPLINE before enabling TRANS_DDI_FUNC_CTL." The patch moves the call to `intel_vrr_set_transcoder_timings` from `hsw_configure_cpu_transcoder` to `intel_vrr_transcoder_enable`, and adds a `WARN_ON` to verify that `TRANS_DDI_FUNC_CTL` is enabled when setting VRR timings.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove VRR transcoder timing setting from hsw_configure_cpu_transcoder to prevent incorrect or duplicate VRR programming.
intent_record.what: Removed call to intel_vrr_set_transcoder_timings(crtc_state) from hsw_configure_cpu_transcoder function.
intent_record.how: The function no longer programs VRR transcoder timings during CPU transcoder configuration, potentially fixing incorrect or redundant VRR timing setup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a guard to warn if VRR timing registers are programmed before the transcoder DDI function is enabled, preventing potential hangs on ICL.
intent_record.what: Added a drm_WARN_ON to check that TRANS_DDI_FUNC_CTL has the TRANS_DDI_FUNC_ENABLE bit set before programming VRR timing registers.
intent_record.how: At runtime, if the VRR function is called before the transcoder DDI function is enabled, a warning with backtrace will be emitted to highlight the programming order violation, which could cause hangs on ICL platforms.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure VRR transcoder timings are set before checking VRR possibility, fixing a missing initialization.
intent_record.what: Added a call to intel_vrr_set_transcoder_timings(crtc_state) at the beginning of intel_vrr_transcoder_enable, before the existing early return check for intel_vrr_possible.
intent_record.how: The function now always sets VRR transcoder timings unconditionally, even when VRR is not possible (the early return still occurs after the call). This ensures the transcoder timings are programmed regardless of VRR enablement.
